description_sq:
Shitet apartament 1+1 tek Oricon Tower, nje nga objektet me te vecanta ne Rrugen Dritan Hoxha, qe tashme po merr jete si nje nga zonat me potencialin me te madh zhvillimi ne Tirane.
I konceptuar si hyrja e re e qytetit, ky projekt modern ofron nje mundesi shume te mire si per banim ashtu edhe per investim afatgjate. Vendndodhja strategjike siguron akses te lehte drejt te gjithe Tiranes, si dhe lidhje te shpejte me Aeroportin Nderkombetar, duke e bere nje zgjedhje ideale per jetese urbane dhe vlere ne rritje.
Apartamenti eshte i organizuar ne menyre funksionale dhe ofron:
• 74.01 m2 siperfaqe neto
• 92.51 m2 siperfaqe bruto
Arkitektura bashkekohore, standardet e larta te ndertimit dhe pozicionimi ne nje zone ne zhvillim e bejne kete prone nje investim te sigurt dhe nje zgjedhje cilesore per banim.
Per me shume informacion, ju ftoj te kontaktoni ne numrin e telefonit ose prane zyres per te marre cdo detaj te nevojshem.
description_en: 1+1 apartment for sale at Oricon Tower, one of the most special facilities on Dritan Hoxha Street, which is now coming to life as one of the areas with the greatest development potential in Tirana. Conceived as the new entrance to the city, this modern project offers a very good opportunity for both residence and long-term investment. The strategic location provides easy access to all of Tirana, as well as quick connections to the International Airport, making it an ideal choice for urban living and increasing value. The apartment is functionally organized and offers: • 74.01 m2 net area • 92.51 m2 gross area Contemporary architecture, high construction standards and positioning in a developing area make this property a safe investment and a quality choice for housing. For more information, I invite you to contact us at the phone number or at the office to get all the necessary details.
